APEX-CITY guide

APEX-CITY is a picture of the paper trading desk. Every tower is one paper bot. It is pretend money only. Real money is off.

Towers

  • Towers look like towers, not televisions.
  • A black tower with dark windows is closed or paused. Its market may be shut, or staff paused it.
  • More lit windows means more trades today.
  • The roof shows today's result: green is up, red is down, gray is flat.
  • A taller tower has a better lifetime result. Losses count. Height is capped so no tower dwarfs the city.
  • Practice towers (shadow towers) stay hidden until they make their first trade. Until then they wait in the hidden lot at the bottom of the tower list.
  • Research buildings never trade. They stand as landmarks.

The tower list

  • Open the Towers menu at the top left. Type in the box to find a tower by name.
  • Tap "card" under a tower to see what it trades, how often it checks, today's result, fees paid, the best and worst trade today, and why it did not trade.
  • A yellow "skip" flag means a learning skip is holding that tower back.
  • A red light means the last check had an error. It clears by itself after a clean check.
  • Practice towers show a bar toward 50 settled results. Their numbers count only after 50. Even then, a move to the desk needs Levi's OK.
  • "Export trades (CSV)" downloads that tower's paper trades, wins and losses.

The banner

  • Real money: off. It always says this.
  • Desk today and lifetime totals include every loss.
  • Stop: how much more the desk can lose today before new buys stop (the $150 daily stop).
  • Open: open trades out of 12. Risk: money at risk out of $100.
  • The clock is Central Time. The day profit uses the Central Time day.
  • "Data is X old" shows how fresh the numbers are. A gray STALE stamp shows after 5 minutes.
  • From 10 PM to 7 AM Central the city dims for quiet hours.
